name: Wavy Hair
description: Wavy hair has a distinct, gentle S-shaped curve that can range from loose and flowing to tight and more defined. This hair type often requires gentle handling due to its natural tendency to curl.
hair_texture: Curly or wavy with defined or subtle curls
characteristics: Can vary from loose to tight waves
common_problems: Dullness and dryness due to overprocessing or chemical treatments
recommended_ingredients: Hydrating ingredients like coconut oil, argan oil, and aloe vera
Humectants such as glycerin and hyaluronic acid
Protein treatments to strengthen the hair structure
Anti-frizz serums containing quaternium-10 or dimethicone
ingredients_to_avoid: Harsh sulfates that can strip natural oils from wavy hair
Alcohol-based products which can dry out the hair
High heat styling tools that can damage the cuticle layer
recommended_product_categories: Heat protectant sprays for styling with heat
washing_frequency: Every 2-3 days, depending on lifestyle and oil production
oil_recommendation: Use lightweight oils like jojoba or argan oil as needed to keep hair moisturized without weighing it down.

morning_routine.action: Rinse hair with cool water to close the cuticle layer
morning_routine.purpose: Prep hair for a smooth texture

night_routine.action: Apply a hydrating leave-in conditioner or moisturizing cream while hair is still damp
night_routine.purpose: Lock in moisture overnight and reduce frizz

night_routine.action: Gently massage the scalp to promote blood circulation
night_routine.purpose: Boost hair growth and overall scalp health

weekly_care: Deep condition once a week using a mask or intensive treatment to replenish moisture
heat_styling_recommendation: Use heat protectant before styling with hot tools, and limit use to avoid damage.
lifestyle_tips: Protect hair from environmental stressors like UV rays by wearing a hat or using UV-protective products
foods_for_healthy_hair: Proteins from eggs, fish, and legumes
Omega-3 fatty acids from flaxseeds and walnuts
Vitamins A, C, and E found in fruits and vegetables
common_mistakes: Over-washing or using too much shampoo can strip natural oils.
Using hot water for washing can open the cuticle layer, leading to dryness.
do: Regularly deep condition with natural ingredients
Use a wide-tooth comb when detangling to avoid breakage
dont: Skip conditioning or skip using heat protectant before styling
Avoid tight hairstyles that can cause tension and breakage

seasonal_care.summer: Protect hair from sun exposure with hats or UV-protective products, use light moisturizers to avoid greasiness.
seasonal_care.winter: Use richer conditioners and oils during colder months to combat dryness and frizz.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Regularly deep condition to manage moisture and salt water damage.

expert_tips: Wear a silk or satin pillowcase to reduce friction during sleep, which can cause breakage.
Apply a leave-in conditioner before blow-drying to help maintain curl definition and prevent heat damage.
